selection_reason: This is the single narrowest existing runtime boundary that already receives the canonical resolver-issued current_app handoff and performs the navigation assignment.

rejected_alternatives.reason: It is destination authority, not a consumer; changing it would alter route truth.
It issues handoffs; adding consumer enforcement there would collapse issuer and consumer responsibilities.
It is the bootstrap root and sits before the Route Guardian consumer boundary.
It is the destination side and would validate after Route Guardian navigation was already assigned.
It loads inside the destination and is too late to block an invalid Route Guardian handoff before navigation.

claim_ceiling: Passive consumer integration and deterministic source-level positive/fail-closed tests only. No isolated runtime proof, browser proof, live-app observation, broad production certification, Unit 3, Unit 4, Unit 5, or Pass 4 work is claimed.
